subject.title: Feature: configurable /new greeting model (or option to suppress greeting)

question: Which public reset-start policy should OpenClaw support for bare `/new` and `/reset` across chat handlers, Gateway `agent`, bootstrap-aware prompts, startup context, and model routing?
rationale: The request adds compatibility-sensitive config and model-routing surface while current main intentionally ships acknowledgement-only resets and related reports ask to restore model turns, so automation should not choose the product contract.

options.title: Define One Reset-Start Policy
options.body: Create a single typed policy that covers ack-only, startup-turn, prompt customization, optional model override, schema, docs, and tests together.

options.title: Keep Ack-Only Default With Opt-In Greeting
options.body: Preserve the shipped cheap reset behavior and expose an explicit mode for persona workflows that need a model greeting.

options.title: Defer New Config
options.body: Keep current static acknowledgements and leave prompt or startup-turn customization to the related discussions until maintainers sponsor the contract.

recommendation.title: Define One Reset-Start Policy
recommendation.body: Create a single typed policy that covers ack-only, startup-turn, prompt customization, optional model override, schema, docs, and tests together.

likelyOwner.reason: This choice spans the acknowledgement branch, config compatibility, Gateway reset behavior, and prior reset-contract review history that steipete most directly touched.
